name: Strong Candied Sweet Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Slice the sweet potatoes and lay in a deep baking pan with the cinnamon stick.
Mix the liquids, zest, cloves, brown sugar and nutmeg together in a pot; bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour liquid mixture over the dish's contents.
Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes or until sweet potatoes appear to be tender and glazed.
Chill for 3 hours, and serve cold.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
